why: The general conjecture remains open with active literature on variants (oriented trees, signed graphs, boxicity-bounded polynomial cases, domatic analogues) that do not count as progress on the stated problem, but a 'A Note on the Gyárfás–Sumner Conjecture' (Graphs and Combinatorics, published online 2024/2025, also as a 2023 arXiv preprint 2302.08922) has a title suggesting it may address the conjecture itself or a specific tree case; could not tell from title/abstract snippets alone whether it settles a case or is expository/simplifying prior work.
